title: False Colours
intro_lines: A brig flies UTC ensigns but handles like a privateer.
Gunports stay shut.
They signal: "Heave to for inspection."

choices.label: Run the black flag up early

outcomes.text: They hesitate, then sheer off — reputation precedes you.
They open fire anyway — a test. Splinters rake the palisade.
A lucky shot cuts your flag halyard. They close fast.

choices.label: Feign compliance, prepare ambush

outcomes.text: Your gunners wait. At point-blank, grapeshot clears their deck.
They suspect a trap. Boarding nets fly. Brutal melee ensues.
Your powder is damp. Misfires. They swarm the breach laughing.

choices.label: Send Tide-Puck to sabotage their anchor

outcomes.text: The beast gnaws the cable. They drift onto the reef, holed.
A sentry spots it. Crossbow bolt wounds Tide-Puck.
It dives too deep, tangles in kelp. Returns empty-jawed.

history_note: Pirates routinely flew false flags — friendly colours until close range — to lure merchants into striking without a fight (Johnson 1724).

title: Muffled Oars
intro_lines: Moonless night.
The surf masks the thup-thup of oars.
Dark shapes glide through the reef channel — longboats.

choices.label: Light the signal fires, rally

outcomes.text: Flames bloom. Pirates hesitate, silhouetted. Volley fire breaks them.
They've grappling hooks. First rank gains the wall. Desperate fighting.
Wet powder. Misfires. They pour over the logs laughing.

choices.label: Slip into the jungle, harass

outcomes.text: Guerrilla arrows and Tide-Puck's ambushes bleed them. They withdraw.
A pirate veteran tracks you. Cutlass slash across the ribs.
You lose them in the dark, but they torch the storehouse.

choices.label: Negotiate — offer tribute for departure

outcomes.text: Their quartermaster accepts. They row off, honouring the bargain.
They take the goods and a hostage — your carpenter.
Captain spits on your gold. "We'll take it all." Boarding resumes.

history_note: Pirate tactics favoured night and dawn boarding from boats with muffled oars to achieve surprise (Johnson 1724).

title: The Ransom Note
intro_lines: An arrow lands at your feet.
Tied: a strip of sailcloth, written in charcoal.
"Carpenter lives. Bring 200 gold, 10 powder, map fragment.

choices.label: Pay the ransom in full

outcomes.text: Carpenter returned unharmed, shaking. "They argued about keeping me."
He's alive but maimed — hand crushed. Building speed halved.
Double-cross. They take goods, leave a corpse. Ambush follows.

choices.label: Tide-Puck tracks them — rescue

outcomes.text: Silent as tide. Carpenter freed, pirates none the wiser. You vanish.
Guard dog barks. Fight erupts. Carpenter stabbed in the scramble.
Tide-Puck corners a pirate — it's the carpenter, turned. He betrays you.

choices.label: Assault their camp at dawn — no quarter

outcomes.text: Cannon and musket shatter their tents. Carpenter rescued, pirates scattered.
They used the carpenter as a shield. He dies in the first volley.
Trap. Their main force waits inland. You're pinned on the beach.

history_note: Pirates took hostages for ransom — Roberts used a captured master to identify the richest Portuguese ship (Johnson 1724).

title: The Rat in the Hold
intro_lines: Your best cutlass goes missing.
Then the powder measure.
A sailor swears he saw a monkey.

choices.label: Set a trap — marked coins

outcomes.text: Next dawn, the cook's pockets jingle. He cracks fast — UTC and pirates.
The bait's gone. No one confesses. Paranoia spreads.
Trap springs wrong — innocent sailor framed. Real spy watches, amused.

choices.label: Feed them false intel — leak a fake

outcomes.text: Pirates hit the decoy. Ambush waits. Two captured, one talks.
They smell the trap. Burn the decoy site. Your spy survives.
UTC patrol hits the site instead. Three-way firefight. Chaos.

choices.label: Tide-Puck hunts the scent trail

outcomes.text: Trail leads to a sea cave. Spy's satchel: UTC cipher, pirate signals.
Spy ambushes Tide-Puck. Poisoned dart. Your companion sickens.
Trail ends at the tide line. Spy swam to a waiting longboat.

history_note: Deserters gave intelligence to pirates — a deserter told Roberts how HMS *Swallow* sailed best (Johnson 1724).

title: Press-Ganged
intro_lines: Dawn raid.
They don't want gold — they want your carpenter.
Grappling hooks on the palisade. "I built these walls.

choices.label: Hide the carpenter, fight the boarders

outcomes.text: Carpenter secreted in a root cellar. Boarders repulsed, cursing.
A pirate finds the hatch. Carpenter fights, takes a cutlass blow.
Overrun. Carpenter dragged off screaming. Walls breached.

choices.label: Let him go — negotiate a trade

outcomes.text: Captain accepts. Carpenter returns with a pirate's grin — and a spy's cipher.
They take the goods and the carpenter. "Changed our minds."
Carpenter refuses to leave. "They need me. I'll sabotage from inside."

choices.label: Tide-Puck creates a diversion

outcomes.text: Beast harries the boarders. Carpenter vanishes into the green. Safe.
Pirate bosun shoots Tide-Puck. Carpenter stays, tends the wound.
Carpenter trips in the roots. Pirates grab him. Tide-Puck howls.

history_note: Pirates recruited — or forced — skilled men: carpenters, surgeons, coopers (Johnson 1724).

title: Channel Ambush
intro_lines: You pursue the pirates — or they lure you.
Walls of coral close in.
Ahead, a hulk lies scuttled across the fairway.

choices.label: Full sail — ram the blockship, board

outcomes.text: Splinters fly. You're aboard their flagship. Quartermaster yields.
Impact throws guns loose. Broadside at point-blank shreds your deck.
The carpenter — their carpenter — springs the trap. Powder magazine blows.

choices.label: Anchor off, land parties on the cliffs

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck guides climbers. Guns spiked. Pirates trapped in the channel.
Cliff paths crumble. Two men fall. Guns fire anyway — channel run costly.
Tideborn scouts on the cliffs. They help — for a relic shard.

choices.label: Parley — offer the carpenter's freedom

outcomes.text: Quartermaster agrees. "A fair trade." Carpenter returned, you sail free.
They take the gold. Carpenter walks the plank. "Nothing personal."
The carpenter stabs the quartermaster. Chaos. You flee in the confusion.

history_note: Pirates ambushed in narrow channels and behind headlands (Johnson 1724).

title: Dawn Landing
intro_lines: First light.
Five longboats grind onto the sand, bows high.
Pirates wade ashore in shirtsleeves. "This beach is ours."

choices.label: Hold the palisade, volley fire by ranks

outcomes.text: Disciplined fire breaks the first wave. Captain falls. They retreat.
They reach the logs. Melee at the gate. Your carpenter holds it shut.
Powder damp from sea air. Click. Click. They pour over laughing.

choices.label: Fallback to the jungle — let them burn

outcomes.text: They loot, burn, leave. You return to ashes — but lives saved.
Scouts track your trail. Skirmish in the ferns. Losses on both sides.
Tideborn appear, drive pirates off. Demand a toll for the favour.

choices.label: Challenge the captain to single combat

outcomes.text: You disarm him. His crew honours the code. They sail at sunset.
He cheats — hidden dagger. You bleed. Crew intervenes, drags him off.
His quartermaster shoots you mid-duel. "Captain's orders." They swarm.

history_note: Pirate tactics favoured dawn boarding from boats to achieve surprise (Johnson 1724).

title: The Black Flag Parley
intro_lines: A sloop anchors off the reef.
Black flag.
No shots fired. A boat comes in under white flag.

choices.label: Refuse — fire a warning shot across

outcomes.text: They weigh anchor, cursing. "Your funeral." But they leave.
Warning shot hits a mast. They return fire — heavy guns.
UTC frigate appears on the horizon. Pirates flee. You're saved.

choices.label: Sign the articles — gain a haven, lose

outcomes.text: You swear. Access to pirate havens, fences, careening beaches.
They make you careen their ships first. Months of unpaid labour.
Articles read: "No quarter to UTC." You're now a marked target.

choices.label: Buy them off — tribute for a year's

outcomes.text: Quartermaster signs a chit. "One year. Then we talk again."
He spits. "Tribute's for kings. We'll take it and the island."
Tide-Puck steals the treaty. Quartermaster laughs. "Keep it."

history_note: Pirates used intimidation to make victims strike without a fight — most prizes surrendered (Johnson 1724).

title: Careening Camp Raid
intro_lines: You find a pirate careening camp — ship heeled.
Guns landed in a sand battery.
Crew drunk on turtle and rum. Tide-Puck circles downwind.

choices.label: Burn the careened ship — strike while

outcomes.text: Flames race up the tarred hull. Magazine explodes. Camp destroyed.
Wind shifts. Fire catches your boat. Desperate escape.
Sentry wakes. Raises alarm. You're pinned on the beach by grape.

choices.label: Steal their stores — food, powder

outcomes.text: Silent as crabs. Wagons loaded. Gone before the hangovers clear.
A pirate stumbles out to piss. Spots Tide-Puck. Chase ensues.
The ship's carpenter catches you. He joins your camp instead.

choices.label: Poison their rum — let fever do the work

outcomes.text: Half the crew dead by dawn. The rest sail, cursed. Camp abandoned.
Ship's surgeon identifies it. He tracks you. Antidote demanded.
Tide-Puck eats the bait. Convulsions. You save it — barely.

history_note: Pirate crews were defenceless while careening; guns often landed in a beach battery (JMU thesis).

title: Marooned
intro_lines: Your own crew turns.
Quartermaster reads the articles aloud.
"Defrauding the company. Theft between mates. One pistol.

choices.label: Accept the sentence — walk the plank

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck swims beside you. You reach a cay. Survival begins.
Sharks circle. Tide-Puck drives them off. You climb a wreck's mast.
The quartermaster tosses you a map fragment. "For old times."

choices.label: Challenge the quartermaster — pistol

outcomes.text: Your ball grazes his thigh. He yields. Crew backs you. Mutiny averted.
His shot takes your ear. Cutlass clash — he's faster. You're marooned.
Tide-Puck lunges for his throat. Crew screams "Witchcraft!" Both exiled.

choices.label: Invoke pirate law — demand a jury

outcomes.text: Haven elders arrive. Evidence reviewed. Charges dismissed. Quartermaster fired.
Elders are bribed. Verdict stands. But they give you a better boat.
Tideborn scouts intercept the boat. "The sea people judge now."

history_note: Pirate articles prescribed marooning with a gun, shot, bottle of water, bottle of powder for defrauding the company (Johnson 1724).

title: The Haven's Tithe
intro_lines: A familiar cutter enters the lagoon — the haven's factor.
"The Brethren's share.
Ten percent of all take. Back-tithe for three moons."

choices.label: Pay the tithe — keep the haven's

outcomes.text: Ledger signed. Haven's guns now cover your anchorage. Safe passage.
Factor pockets half. You learn. Leverage for next time.
UTC warship follows the factor in. Haven burns. You're on your own.

choices.label: Refuse — fortify, call in Tideborn

outcomes.text: Walls rise. Tideborn archers man the palisade. Factor leaves, threatening.
Pirate fleet arrives. Siege. You hold, but stores bleed dry.
Factor returns with a royal pardon for your crew. Mutiny brews.

choices.label: Sell the factor to UTC — his ledger

outcomes.text: UTC pays handsomely. Factor vanishes. Haven's economy collapses.
Factor escapes. Warns the Brethren. You're hostis humani generis.
Tideborn intercept the trade. "We know what you did." Relic demanded.

history_note: The haven chain — haven, victualler, receiver, protector — sustained pirate economies (Sailing the Black Flag).
